schema.operator: Name of a check type in the operator list, read as a sentence: <expression> matches schema. Compares a value with a JSON Schema.
schema.root: Start of a sentence about the whole value being checked, for example: The value should be a string.
schema.type: {{where}} is either The value or a path such as $.items[0]. {{expected}} is a list of allowed kinds, {{actual}} describes what was found.
schema.enum: {{allowed}} is a list of allowed values, written as JSON.
schema.const: {{expected}} is the only allowed value, written as JSON.
schema.minLength: Counts characters of a text. {{actual}} is the length found.
schema.contains: At least this many array items must match the schema.
schema.dependentRequired: JSON Schema dependentRequired: when the field in {{present}} exists, {{needed}} is also required.
schema.anyOf: Followed on the next lines by the reasons the closest shape failed.
schema.mismatch: {{problems}} is a list of lines, one per problem.
schema.notJson: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces.
schema.editorHint: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces.
schema.edit: Button that opens the JSON Schema editor.
contract.heading: Heading of the group of checks comparing a response with an OpenAPI spec.
contract.status: {{status}} is an HTTP status code, {{key}} is the operation such as GET /todos.
contract.noContentType: Shown when the response has no Content-Type.
contract.link: Menu item; the ellipsis means a window follows.
contract.linkConfirm: Confirm button that links an OpenAPI spec to a folder.
responseChecks.button: Button that turns the last response into checks. Hidden on narrow screens except for its tooltip.
responseChecks.addCount: Confirm button of the dialog that lists suggested checks.
responseChecks.added: Notice. {{name}} is the name of a request.
tests.sectionLabel: Accessible label of the Checks section of a request.
tests.views.assertions: Name of the tab where checks are written as rows (no code).
tests.expression: Column heading: the value being checked, for example res.status.
tests.check: Column heading: the kind of comparison, for example equals.
tests.expected: Column heading: the value to compare with.
tests.hints.assertions: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces. Keep names such as res.status unchanged.
tests.verify: Tooltip of the button that runs one check against the last response.
tests.results: Accessible label of the list of check results.
checkRun.stage: Name of the step of a run where checks are evaluated; shown with errors.
checkRun.resolvedValue: {{value}} is what a variable resolved to, {{written}} is the text the user wrote.
checkRun.outsideResponse: {{expression}} is what the user wrote, {{suggestion}} is the corrected path in code.
checkRun.unknownOperator: {{names}} is a comma-separated list of valid check identifiers; do not translate them.
jsonPath.blocked: {{name}} is a JavaScript name a JSONPath filter is not allowed to use.
operators.eq: Reads after an expression: res.status equals 200. Keep it a verb phrase.
operators.gt: Reads after an expression: is greater than 5.
operators.gte: Reads after an expression: is at least 5.
operators.in: Value is one of a list.
operators.isDefined: A field exists and has a value.
checkRun.valueWas: Explains why a check failed. {{value}} is the actual value as JSON text, for example 404 or "ok". No full stop, so a following line can be appended.
schema.save: Button that saves the JSON Schema being edited. Verb.
schema.kinds: Names of JSON value types, used inside the problem messages of this group as {{expected}} and {{actual}} ("should be a string, but it is a number"). Each reads as it would after "should be". Adjust the article or form to fit that sentence.
schema.previewArray: Short description of an array value that fills {{actual}} in a problem message. {{count}} is the number of items.
schema.previewObject: Short description of an object value that fills {{actual}} in a problem message.
schema.previewText: Short description of a text value that fills {{actual}} in a problem message. {{text}} is the text itself, shortened when long.
schema.more: Last line of a list of problems when some are not shown. {{count}} is the number of hidden problems. The ellipsis at the start is part of the message.
